blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1860-267-6789 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.

blocking_methods.label: alternate
blocking_methods.instructions: Call +91-44-6904-6789 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email customer.care@dbs.com from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://www.dbs.com/india and use the card block/hotlist option.
Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dbs.digibank | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/dbs-digibank/id1133705384
